final: WITH ar AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS signed_total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), rr AS (SELECT region, SUM(signed_total) AS region_sum FROM ar GROUP BY region) SELECT ar.account_id, ar.region, ar.signed_total, ar.cnt, (ar.signed_total * 1.0) / rr.region_sum AS ratio FROM ar JOIN rr ON ar.region = rr.region ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC LIMIT 10
